skytrace.description: Interactive multi-wavelength exploration of NASA SPHEREx sky observations and transient candidate discovery engine across 102 spectroscopic bands.
skytrace.text_summary: SkyTrace NASA SPHEREx Discovery Platform NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 Launch Explorer Planet X and SPHEREx — Multi-Epoch Astronomical Transient Engine Explore the Sky. Compare the Evidence. Investigate real multi-epoch infrared sky observations from NASA IRSA across 102 spectroscopic bands. Discover moving asteroids, ultra-cool brown dwarfs, and candidate trans-Neptunian objects through differential photometry and honest scientific evidence. Launch 3D Celestial Explorer Open Blink Comparator Engine 102 Spectroscopic Channels 0.75 – 5.0 µm All-Sky 6.2″ Pixel Plate Scale WCS TAN Astrometry 4 Physical SED Templates Reduced χ² Minimization QR3 NASA IRSA Data Release SIA2 & IBE Live Pipeline Featured Investigation Showcases Pre-computed Multi-Epoch Baselines Methane Ice Signature Band 88 Planet X & Kuiper Belt Search Sedna Recovery Sector ( 56.5 °, +7.9 °) Search for high-eccentricity trans-Neptunian objects and potential distant planets via characteristic solid-state CH4 surface ice absorption and high annual parallax. Predicted Distance : > 300 AU Diagnostic Band : 4.26 µm CO2/CH4 Expected Parallax : < 40 mas Launch Investigation Sub-Stellar Atmosphere Band 33 Orion Nebula Y-Dwarf Nursery M42 Active Star Formation ( 83.8 °, -5.4 °) Identify ultra-cool brown dwarfs (T < 450 K) embedded in the Orion starburst complex using differential photometry and diagnostic 1.65 µm atmospheric methane windows. Effective Temp : 380 - 450 K Molecular Features : CH4, H2O, NH3 Cataloged Passes : 48 Epochs Launch Investigation Calibration Benchmark Band 50 North Ecliptic Pole Deep Survey Continuous Viewing Zone ( 270.0 °, +66.6 °) Deepest survey pointing in the SPHEREx all-sky map with over 100 overlapping passes, serving as the benchmark for cosmic infrared background (CIB) fluctuation studies. Overlapping Passes : > 100 Passes Astrometric Error : < 0.05″ RMS Primary Array : Array 3 (Ks) Launch Investigation SkyTrace Discovery Engine • NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 • SPHEREx QR3 Data Release 3D Explorer Blink Viewer NASA IRSA
